name: DebugFpsOverlayFormat
description: KTGL built-in perf overlay: prints "-- KTGL For DX12(x64)[2.17.0] CS[sRGB|Linear] --", then (level d+76F8 >0) "PU CLCK"/"V  WAIT"/"FPS %2.2f(%4.2f)" from QPC deltas (d+7700 last QPC, d+7708 present-call QPC) and (level >1) "-- KTGL PLATFORM INFO --"/PSO counts into the debug text console d+76F0; saves/restores render state around it; does nothing while d+76F0 == 0 (always in retail: its only setter 2EEBEE4 has no references) (aka KtglDebugPerfOverlay)

name: RenderFrameDebugOverlay
description: called from RenderWaitForFrame (4A512F) and 5 others: 4A39FC(d+61A0,d); if d+76F0 -> DebugFpsOverlayFormat(d); 4A365C(d,p2)

name: GfxDeviceSetDebugTextConsole
signature: void(GfxDevice* d, DebugTextConsole* c, int level)
description: leaf: d+76F0 = c, d+76F8 = level; no pdata, zero rel32 and zero absolute-pointer references in the dump -> dead in retail, so the KTGL perf overlay can never be switched on by a flag

name: DebugTextPuts
description: binds the console font page (c+38 table, c+40 index, device c+48; emits KTGL token 0x44/0x4C on change) then DebugTextPutChar per byte; 13 callers (KTGL perf overlay, 365Cxxx/2F13xxx debug panels)

name: DebugTextPrintf
description: _vsnprintf into a 0x400 stack buffer, then DebugTextPuts; 25 callers

name: DebugOverlayUserCallback
description: calls cb+50(cb, c, cb+30, cb+38, cb+40) under the critical section g_QpcTimer+0x90; reached from DebugFpsOverlayFormat via GfxDevice+7710

name: KtglEmitToken70
description: 1DAA5C(d+2530) then writes KTGL token 0x70 at d+3C40; 125 callers incl. the perf overlay (begin of a 2D/debug draw block?)

name: GfxDevice::DebugTextConsole
description: console used by the KTGL perf overlay; 0 in retail (setter 2EEBEE4 unreferenced); RenderWaitForFrame resets its row/col each frame when set

name: GfxDevice::DebugOverlayLevel
description: >0 FPS lines, >1 platform info + PSO stats

name: GfxDevice::DebugOverlayLastQpc
description: QPC of the previous perf-overlay frame (FPS = QPF / delta)

name: GfxDevice::DebugOverlayCallback
description: optional user callback printed after the FPS block

name: DebugTextConsole::Color
description: ARGB text colour (0xAF2FAF2F / 0xAF5FAFAF / 0xAFFFFFFF in the perf overlay)

name: DebugTextConsole::Device
description: device whose token stream (+3C40) receives the text
